page.content:
Spinjitzu ninja theme with Lloyd, the four elemental ninja, and a long cartoon.

How NINJAGO connects

  • Topic: LEGO — NINJAGO is the long-running ninja theme of the brick system.
  • Character: Lloyd Garmadon — Lloyd Garmadon leads the ninja of NINJAGO as the Green Ninja.

What is NINJAGO?

NINJAGO is the ninja theme of Lloyd Garmadon, Kai, Cole, Jay, and Zane, backed by a television serial that made Spinjitzu and elemental powers a durable brick story world.

Key threads lead to LEGO and Lloyd Garmadon.
